ui.disclaimer: The terms, amount, deadline and criteria of scholarships change. Before proceeding, check the official page of the university or the offering institution.
ui.examIntro: Before registering, confirm the type of test and required score directly from the destination university or department.

countries.name: Germany
countries.summary: Germany has a variety of programs in public and private universities. Check the cost of living, program language and visa requirements separately.

countries.name: Britain
countries.summary: Britain has intensive and extensive English language courses. Check the tuition, city fee and language test credit in the desired program.

countries.name: France
countries.summary: In France, the language of instruction varies between programs. Follow the registration fee, language, accommodation and visa route from the official source.

countries.name: Italy
countries.summary: Italy has English and Italian programs. Compare tuition, financial aid and living conditions separately for each region.

countries.name: Holland
countries.summary: Holland has many English programs; But plan the cost of living and housing carefully before applying.

countries.name: Türkiye
countries.summary: Türkiye has Turkish and English education options. Carefully check the accreditation of the university, the language of instruction and the actual cost of the city.

countries.name: Hungary
countries.summary: Hungary offers several English-language programs. Check the conditions of admission, accommodation and insurance from the university.

countries.name: Albania
countries.summary: For Albania, check language of instruction, program accreditation and residency options directly from the university and embassy.

countries.name: Ireland
countries.summary: Ireland has English language programs and an active research environment. Reconfirm tuition, accommodation and visa requirements at the time of application.

exams.name: IELTS
exams.summary: IELTS is used to measure English language proficiency. The destination university or department determines which type of test and what grade it accepts.
sections: Choose Academic or General type based on your purpose.
Ask the destination program for the minimum total score and each skill.
Leave room in your schedule for the result and the possibility of retesting.

exams.name: TOEFL
exams.summary: TOEFL measures English language proficiency for many university programs. Confirm the acceptance of the test copy and the minimum score from the destination.
sections: Check the exam condition of the same university and field.
Know the official method of sending the result and its validity.
Prepare for each skill with sample tests and regular schedules.

exams.name: Duolingo English Test
exams.summary: Duolingo online test measures English language skills. Confirm the acceptance of the test and the minimum score from the destination university.
sections: Check the list of accepted universities.
Prepare the test environment and equipment in advance.
Record the grade required for the destination program.

exams.name: SAT
exams.summary: The SAT is used for admission to some undergraduate programs. The requirement and required score depends on the university and the program.
sections: Check the SAT requirement from the university.
Plan for math and reading sections.
Record the deadline for sending the result.

exams.name: GRE
exams.summary: GRE is used in admission to some graduate courses. Confirm the need for the test from the destination program.
sections: Check the GRE requirement of the same field.
Practice quantitative, verbal and written sections.
Check the university result submission code.

exams.name: GMAT
exams.summary: GMAT is used for some management and business programs. Ask the university for the accepted version and score.
sections: Practice for Quantitative Sections and Reasoning.
Check the deadline and method of sending the result.
